text:
deploybot: Pin applied: runtime v3.2.1 -> model-group 'precise-longseq'. Reason: quant kernel regression causing 95th pct latency spikes. Pin TTL 2026-03-24T08:00Z. Change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Owner: @alex.

alex: ack. I'm taking lead for cordon and rollout. will limit traffic to reserve capacity and stagger canaries.

maya: is this global? can we scope to eu-west first? APAC customers saw impact earlier.

alex: yes can scope. plan = eu-west cordon -> observe 30m -> us-west -> rest. leaving small hosted capacity for critical traffic.

sam: @alex I'll prep the hotpatch branch for rollback (v3.2.0 artifact) and the deploy playbook. ETA ~20m.

priya: note: SDK 2.9.1 includes the kv-cache shim that depends on runtime v3.2.1 behavior. rollback will require toggling shim off via feature-flag. Adding to checklist.

oncall: adding runbook link and metric dashboards: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/precise-longseq-pin and https://grafana.company/d/longseq-pin

sam: hotpatch branch created: gitlab.com/redwood/runtime/-/tree/hotfix/rollback-3.2.0-hotpatch. Deploy command for rollback ready:
```
/deploy rollback runtime precise-longseq --to v3.2.0 --region eu-west --hotpatch true
```

alex: checklist for tonight (short): 1) cordon region (eu-west) 2) route 10% traffic to fallback models 3) monitor latency & error-rate 4) apply hotpatch if degradation persists 5) lift pin when metrics stable.

maya: will notify cs about regional scope and update status page. tagging @oncall for midnight watch. :thumbsup:

oncall: I'm on standby. will watch the 95th/99th latency panels and alert if SLO breach. react with :eyes: when we start cordon.

deploybot: Note: autoscaler cooldown extended for pinned cohorts, burst capacity limited to 30% to avoid noisy neighbor effects.

alex: great. pushing a short slack update to #support and #status once eu-west cordon starts. ping here when cordon begins.

sam: starting rollout prep now. will post back with deployment snippet and timestamps.

priya: logging the SDK shim toggle steps in the runbook now so rollback is atomic.

alex: thanks team. moving to action. (reacted :rocket:)
